title: Containment, PPE, Contents and Debris Rates under Water Damage Mitigation
content:
The Water Damage Mitigation rate schedule for site protection and clean-out sets, per tier, the containment barrier fee, the PPE rate and whether PPE is billable, the in-room contents manipulation rate, the debris haul-off rate per pickup-truck load and the roll-off dumpster fee.

| Tier | Containment (each) | PPE per technician-day | PPE billable | Contents manipulation per room | Debris haul-off per load | Dumpster per placement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $395.00 | $18.40 | No | $64.80 | $214.00 | $585.00 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $355.50 | $18.40 | No | $58.32 | $192.60 | $526.50 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $395.00 | $28.75 | Yes | $64.80 | $214.00 | $585.00 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $355.50 | $28.75 | Yes | $58.32 | $192.60 | $526.50 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $445.00 | $46.20 | Yes | $72.40 | $238.00 | $615.00 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $400.50 | $46.20 | Yes | $65.16 | $214.20 | $553.50 |

## Schedule definitions
- **Containment**: Poly containment barrier with zipper door, per containment, USD.
- **PPE**: Personal protective equipment per technician per day, USD.
- **PPE billable**: Whether PPE is a billable line on the job, boolean.
- **Contents manipulation**: Moving and blocking contents within the room (no packout) per room, USD.
- **Debris haul-off**: Debris haul-off per pickup-truck load, USD.
- **Dumpster**: Roll-off dumpster (20 cubic yard) per placement, USD.

## Notes
- PPE is a billable line on the Gray Water Mitigation and Black Water Mitigation tiers only; the Clean Water Mitigation tiers list a PPE rate but do not bill it.
- The debris haul-off figure in this schedule is the tier's fee for one pickup-truck load.
